description: You are a macOS sysadmin completing a security and compliance audit of the macFUSE filesystem framework that is installed on this workstation. Open Terminal and produce a JSON audit report at /Users/lume/Documents/macfuse_audit_report.json. The JSON must be a single top-level object with the following keys (exact spelling, exact types) populated from the live state of THIS machine — not values you have memorized from documentation: `bundle_version` (string: the macFUSE filesystem bundle's CFBundleShortVersionString), `bundle_identifier` (string: the macFUSE filesystem bundle's CFBundleIdentifier), `pkg_core_version` (string: the version of the `io.macfuse.installer.components.core` installer package as reported by pkgutil), `core_pkg_install_time` (integer: the Unix epoch `install-time` of the io.macfuse.installer.components.core package as reported by `pkgutil --pkg-info`), `prefpane_pkg_install_time` (integer: the Unix epoch `install-time` of the io.macfuse.installer.components.preferencepane package as reported by `pkgutil --pkg-info`), `kext_currently_loaded` (boolean: whether any macFUSE kernel extension is currently loaded in the running kernel), `mount_helper_path` (string: the absolute path to the macFUSE mount helper binary inside the bundle), `supported_macos_versions_count` (integer: the number of macOS-version-named subdirectories under the bundle's Contents/Extensions/ folder), `libfuse_dylib_count` (integer: the count of files in /usr/local/lib/ whose names match the glob libfuse*.dylib), `prefpane_installed` (boolean: whether the macFUSE preference pane bundle is present at its standard /Library/PreferencePanes/ location).

metadata.scoring_notes: Per-field scoring is binary (full or 0). Two fields (core_pkg_install_time, prefpane_pkg_install_time) are sandbox-specific and unfakable — together they account for 40 of 100 points, so an agent that only guesses public macFUSE facts without probing the live install cannot reach the 70-point pass threshold.
